sentences.text: (NYSE: PWR), a Houston-based infrastructure services company serving electric power, renewable energy, pipeline and communications markets.
Quanta's board named him to succeed Jim O'Neil as president and CEO in March 2016, when he was chief operating officer, and also appointed him to the board of directors.

He had served as COO since January 2013, earlier led the Electric Power and Natural Gas and Pipeline divisions, and was president of North Houston Pole Line, L.P., now a Quanta subsidiary, from 2001 to 2009.

mgmt_bio.text: Earl C. "Duke" Austin, Jr. is president and chief executive officer of Quanta Services, Inc. (NYSE: PWR), a Houston-based infrastructure services company serving electric power, renewable energy, pipeline and communications markets. He holds a B.S. in business management/accounting from Sam Houston State University. He also serves on the Texas State University System Board of Regents.

sentences.quote: The company achieved a record backlog of $53 billion, reflecting robust demand across its end markets.
sentences.text: Quanta Services ended the second quarter of 2026 with a record total backlog of $53 billion, reflecting broad demand across its end markets.
Second-quarter growth was broad-based across utility, generation, technology and infrastructure markets and was driven mainly organically rather than by acquisitions.
Management raised full-year 2026 guidance to revenues of $39.3-39.7 billion, adjusted EBITDA of $4.1-4.2 billion, adjusted EPS of $16.45-16.95 and free cash flow of $2.0-2.5 billion.

thesis_pillars.text: Quanta Services ended the second quarter of 2026 with a record total backlog of $53 billion, reflecting broad demand across its end markets. Quanta attributes execution certainty to its self-perform capabilities and craft-skilled workforce. Capital returns and credit strength improved, with a new $1 billion buyback authorized in May 2026 and a Moody's upgrade of senior unsecured notes to Baa2 in June 2026.
